name: Seinarukana Special Fan Disc
original_name: 聖なるかな スペシャルファンディスク
source:
This is a fan disc of Seinarukana -The Spirit of Eternity Sword 2-. The disc features three afterstories and a quiz game with more scenes.. Also, a maxi single CD is included.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081224055039/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010356]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
本作是《圣なるかな-The Spirit of Eternity Sword 2-》的Fan Disc，收录三篇后日谈和一款含有更多场景的问答游戏。此外还附带一张Maxi Single CD。

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081224055039/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010356]ErogeShop[/url]]
